_about: Attendance badges on the phone app's Home (owner, 21 Nov 2026). Each company can change, remove or add badges here. type: streak (n on-time days in a row) | on_time (n on-time days) | present (n present days) | early (count days punched in at least minutes before shift) | zero_late (no late day) | no_absent (whole month, no absent day) | hours (h hours worked). icon: star | sun | bolt | trophy | fire | clock | medal | heart. Counted per calendar month.

badges.name: Perfect week
badges.about: Be on time 5 working days in a row.

badges.name: Early bird
badges.about: Punch in at least 15 minutes before your shift starts.

badges.name: Zero late
badges.about: Go the whole month without a late day.

badges.name: Full month
badges.about: No absent day in the whole month.

badges.name: Punctual 15
badges.about: Be on time on 15 working days this month.

badges.name: 160 club
badges.about: Work 160 hours or more this month.

badges.name: On fire
badges.about: Be on time 10 working days in a row.
